in_sanskrit.name: Titu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, Small
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Titu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Titu is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'tit', which means 'little' or 'small'. In Hindu culture, it is a common name for boys and is often used as a term of endearment or affection.
